title: Behind the code
sub_title: I like bringing people and technology closer through code and digital content. Clear, useful, well-made experiences, that's the goal.

description.title: The road so far
description.begin: Nice to meet you! I'm Felipe Frantz Zanini, a software engineer who loves jiu-jitsu, running, indie games, Dota 2, screenwriting, pixel art, music, and investing. I'm 33 and live in Pelotas, Rio Grande do Sul, Brazil.
description.middle: I started in software in 2008, during technical school. In 2010 I finished the course, landed my first programming internship, and I've been at it ever since. I was hired as a software engineer that same year, and I've worked on more than 90 projects with PHP, JavaScript, Ruby, Python, plus plenty of frameworks and libraries.
description.education: I've always wanted to keep learning. I finished a degree in IT Management, a specialization in Strategic IT Planning, and started a Master's in Computer Science, which I didn't finish for personal reasons. With AI moving so fast, I'm now doing a postgraduate program in AI and automation so I can stay current and keep growing.
description.end: These days I'm a Senior Software Engineer & Frontend Architect at Iguatemi S.A., where I help build digital products that make life easier for retailers and customers across the network.

skills.title: How I run a project
skills.subtitle: A look at my process for turning ideas into digital products

process.title: Understanding the motivation
process.description: It always starts with a conversation. I listen to what you want, why it matters, and then figure out a practical way to make it look good and actually work.

process.title: Building the structure
process.description: Before I worry about how it looks, I map the structure: which pages we need, how things should behave, and how it all connects.

process.title: Bringing the code to life
process.description: Then I build it. I care about usability, responsiveness, and performance, so it feels fast and easy on any device.

process.title: External integrations
process.description: If we need forms, auth, or hooks into other systems, I take that on too. Security and stability stay non-negotiable.

process.title: Testing and quality assurance
process.description: Before it goes live, I test it. Different browsers, devices, screen sizes, real-world use. I want it to work the way we planned.

process.title: Time to show the world
process.description: Then I ship it. In the first few days I keep an eye on things and jump in if anything comes up.

stack.title: The gears behind the process
stack.description: Behind every click and line of code are technologies I picked on purpose. If you want the full stack or just want to say hi, the buttons below will get you there.
